info.name: Leader API
info.description:
Leader / ليدر backend — every endpoint, runnable top-to-bottom against a seeded local database (`npm run seed`).

Run order matters: the first folder signs in the seeded accounts and stores their tokens in collection variables.
Full guide: backend/docs/FRONTEND-INTEGRATION-GUIDE.md
